_lisez_moi: Text of the full questionnaire (public/js/questionnaire.js): steps, questions, and labels of multiple-choice answers (« options »: the key is the saved value, in French; the value is the label shown). Same keys as src/contenu/fr/questionnaire.json.

activite.intro: These answers feed the teaser (anonymized) and the memorandum. Write simply, as you would to a buyer: nothing is made up for you.

description.libelle: What the company does, in a few sentences
description.aide: Trade, know-how, what sets it apart.

clientele.libelle: Your customers: who are they? (consumers, businesses, industries)

equipe.libelle: The team: key roles, management, length of service

atouts.intro: What makes the company valuable in a buyer’s eyes.

developpement.libelle: Growth opportunities a buyer could pursue

operation.intro: What you are looking for: these details appear in the teaser and the memorandum.

part_cedee.libelle: Share of the capital to sell

motif.aide: For example: retirement, a new project.

accompagnement.libelle: Transition support offered to the buyer
accompagnement.aide: Length and form of the handover.

dirigeant.intro: To compare the company with an equivalent one run by a salaried manager, we bring your pay back to a “normal” level.

remuneration_dirigeant_reelle.libelle: Your actual annual pay, including payroll taxes
remuneration_dirigeant_reelle.aide: Salary + payroll taxes + benefits paid by the company.

remuneration_normative.libelle: What a salaried manager replacing you would cost, including payroll taxes
remuneration_normative.aide: Your estimate; your accountant can help. Leave blank if you don’t know.

role_dirigeant.libelle: What you alone handle today (customers, production, management)
role_dirigeant.aide: Used to assess how much the company depends on you personally.

retraitements.intro: Some amounts in the accounts won’t recur for a buyer. Every adjustment must be justified.

loyer_paye.libelle: Annual rent paid, if you own the premises (or a family property company does)
loyer_paye.aide: Leave blank if the premises belong to a third party.

loyer_marche.libelle: Annual market rent for equivalent premises

exceptionnels.libelle: One-off expenses or income included in EBITDA
exceptionnels.aide: Positive amount: an expense to add back (EBITDA goes up). Negative: income to remove.

clients.intro: Revenue concentration and recurrence weigh on the value.

part_premier_client.libelle: Share of revenue from your largest customer

part_cinq_clients.libelle: Share from your top five customers

part_recurrente.libelle: Share of recurring revenue (contracts, subscriptions, loyal customers)

regions.libelle: Regions where your main customers are
regions.aide: They will be marked on the memorandum map.

perspectives.intro: Your estimate, presented as such in the memorandum. Without an answer, nothing is shown in its place.

investissements_pct.libelle: Planned annual capital expenditure, as a % of revenue

bilan.intro: These items can’t always be read from the tax return; they are used to go from enterprise value to the value of your shares.

dividendes_a_verser.libelle: Dividends declared but not yet paid

plus_values_latentes.libelle: Unrealized gains (real estate, goodwill) that you can justify

frais_etablissement.libelle: Start-up costs still on the balance sheet

capital_personnes_physiques.libelle: Is at least 75% of the capital held by individuals?
capital_personnes_physiques.aide: A condition for the reduced 15% corporate income tax rate (with revenue ≤ €10M).

murs.À vous ou à votre famille (souvent une S: You or your family (often through a property company)

murs_cession.Non, un bail sera proposé au repreneur: No, a lease will be offered to the buyer
